measures.condition: Special tax rate for copper exporters ("Optional Register of Copper Exports"). Reference values:.(i) base value: USD 7,700/tn.(ii) reference value: USD 11,500/tn.(iii) international price: on the last business day of each month, the Mining Secretariat will publish the listing price of grade A copper ton, cathodes, on the London Metal Exchange..Cases:.1- If the international price is equal to or less than the base value: 0% (export tax rate). 2- If the international price is equal to or higher than the reference value: 8% (export tax rate). 3- A special formula is applied to define the export tax rate if the international price is higher than t
measures.purpose: Promote further processing / value added; Protect local downstream industry; Safeguard domestic supply
measures.document: Decreto 308/2022
measures.legalBasis: Decreto 308/2022
measures.note: The "Optional Register of Copper Exports" is created. Legal entities that invest in starting new productive projects can voluntarily adhere to this Register (i.e. it is not mandatory). It only applies to products 2603.00.10, 2603.00.90, and 2620.30.00. A "special tax rate" is applied to registered persons as an export tax; various cases are contemplated. Registered persons can stay in this scheme for 30 years from their registration date. For legal entities that choose not to register, the export tax of decree 1060/2020 applies.

measures.document: Decreto Supremo 29577-2008
measures.note: The mining royalty is an ad valorem tax applied to the gross sales value - the latter being determined according to the official minimum price established fortnightly by the Ministry of Mining and Metallurgy on the basis of the average of daily international prices. The mining royalty rate is 2.5% when the mineral is exported (the mining royalty rate is 1.5% when the mineral is sold on the domestic market). Of the 15% received by the municipality, at least 85% will be devoted to public investment, of which 50% will be devoted to projects related to the impact of the mining operations (article 27 of the Supreme Decree 29577-2008). This applies to the mining royalty that is to be paid for both exports and domestic sales.

measures.document: Ministerial decision 15/2021 issuing the regulation governing the export of waste
measures.legalBasis: Environmental Protection and Pollution Control Law issued by Royal Decree No. 2/114
measures.note: License from the Environment authority and license fee = 35 rial/t. Companies and commercial shops that produce and deal with hazardous and non-hazardous waste must keep a record which includes the produced waste, indicating in it what was sold of that waste, as well as what was disposed of and the methods of the disposal thereof, and the record must be shown to the Environment Authority or competent authorities upon their request. Priority shall be given to local markets.
